data.name: PomPomMomonga
data.detailed_description:
PomPom Momonga – Game Description

PomPom Momonga is a thrilling jump action game set on a crumbling floating island.
Dash through the stages using double jumps, wall kicks, and aerial hovering to survive the imminent dangers.
With short, fast-paced stages and a variety of traps and enemy characters, the game delivers exhilarating action that keeps both beginners and advanced players coming back for more.

【Note】In-game text and voice, as well as the AI text generation feature, are only available in “English” and “Japanese”.

World and Story

A Post-Apocalyptic Floating Island
The land that once supported humanity was shattered by the “Terminal Tremor.” Humans now live on floating artificial islands above the ground.

Imminent Danger
Even these floating islands are deteriorating, and standing still can make the ground beneath you collapse in a thrillingly precarious environment.

Player’s Goal
Leap across crumbling platforms to reach the next safe stage and survive.

Gameplay and Action

Exhilarating Jump Action
Use double jumps, wall kicks, and aerial hovering to navigate through the stages.

Diverse Stage Gimmicks
Stages feature falling platforms, rotating blocks, sliding traps, and more, testing your timing and jumping skills.

Unique Enemy Characters
Enemies with different behaviors appear throughout the stages. Strategically avoiding or outmaneuvering them is key to success.

Stages and Challenges

Quick, Enjoyable Stages
Each stage can be completed in just a few minutes, making it perfect for quick play sessions.

High Replayability

Compete against your own best times with score and time attack challenges.

Player Experience

Sense of Growth and Skill
Repeatedly playing stages allows you to improve your jumping technique and reaction speed.

Fun for Beginners and Experts
Simple controls make it accessible, while timing and combo actions provide depth for advanced players.

Unique World and Visuals
The collapsing floating islands, colorful stage designs, and dynamic action effects make for an engaging visual experience.
